# **Problem 2**

## (a)
```{r}
bubble_sort = function(vec, decreasing = FALSE)
{
  n = length(vec)
  
  if (n < 2) return(vec)     
  
  for (i in 1:(n-1))
  {
    for(j in 1:(n-i))
    {
      if (decreasing == FALSE)
      {
        if (vec[j] > vec[j+1])
        {
          temp = vec[j]
          vec[j] = vec[j+1]
          vec[j+1] = temp
        }
      }
      else
      {
        if (vec[j] < vec[j+1])
        {
          temp = vec[j]
          vec[j] = vec[j+1]
          vec[j+1] = temp
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return(vec)
}

set.seed(1)
x = runif(10)
bubble_sort(x, decreasing = FALSE)    
bubble_sort(x, decreasing = TRUE)     
```


## (b)
```{r}
quick_sort = function(vec, decreasing = FALSE)
{
  n = length(vec)
  
  if (n < 2) return (vec)      
  
  pivot = vec[1]   
  
  left = c()
  right = c()
  
  for (j in 2:n)
  {
    if (decreasing == FALSE)
    {
      if (vec[j] <= pivot)
      {
        left = c(left, vec[j])
      }
      else
      {
        right = c(right, vec[j])
      }
    }
    else
    {
      if (vec[j] >= pivot)
      {
        left = c(left, vec[j])
      }
      else
      {
        right = c(right, vec[j])
      }
    }
  }
  left = quick_sort(left, decreasing)
  right = quick_sort(right, decreasing)
  
  return(c(left, pivot, right))
}

set.seed(1)
x = runif(10)
quick_sort(x, decreasing = FALSE)    
quick_sort(x, decreasing = TRUE)     
```




# **Problem 3**

## (a)
```{r}
numerical_diff = function(f, x, h = 1e-6, method = "central")
{
  if (method == "forward")
  {
    result = (f(x+h) - f(x)) / h
  }
  else if (method == "backward")
  {
    result = (f(x) - f(x-h)) / h
  }
  else if (method == "central")
  {
    result = (f(x+h) - f(x-h)) / (2*h)
  }
  return(result)
}

f = function(x)
{
  return(cos(x) - x)
}

f_prime = function(x)
{
  return(-sin(x) - 1)
}



x = seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 100)

y_forward = numerical_diff(f, x, method = "forward")
y_backward = numerical_diff(f, x, method = "backward")
y_central = numerical_diff(f, x, method = "central")


y_true = f_prime(x)


library(ggplot2)

df = data.frame(
  x = x,
  Forward = y_forward,
  Backward = y_backward,
  Central = y_central,
  Analytical = y_true
)

p = ggplot(df, aes(x = x, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Forward, color = "Forward")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Backward, color = "Backward")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Central, color = "Central")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Analytical, color = "Analytical"),
            linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Forward" = "red",
    "Backward" = "blue",
    "Central" = "yellow",
    "Analytical" = "black"
  )) +
  labs(x = "x", y = "Derivative", color = "Method")

print(p)

ggsave("plots/problem3.png", plot = p)
```


## (b)
```{r}
newtown_rapshon = function(f, fprime = NULL, x0, maxiter = 100, h = 1e-6, epsilon = 1e-10)
{
  x_t_1 = x0
  
  for (t in 1:maxiter)
  {
    if(is.null(fprime))
    {
      derivative = numerical_diff(f, x_t_1, h = h, method = "central")
    }
    else
    {
      derivative = fprime(x_t_1)
    }
    
    # Newton-Rapshon 
    x_t = x_t_1 - f(x_t_1) / derivative
    
    if (abs(x_t - x_t_1) < epsilon)
    {
      return(x_t)
    }
    
    x_t_1 = x_t
  }
  return(x_t_1)
}
```


## (c)

```{r}
root_analytical
```




# **Problem 4**

## (a)
```{r}
left_rectangle = function(f, a, b, n)
{
  h = (b - a) / n
  result = 0
  
  for (i in 0:(n-1))
  {
    x_i = a + i * h
    result = result + f(x_i)
  }
  result = h * result
  
  return (result)
}
```


## (b)
```{r}
trapezoid = function(f, a, b, n)
{
  h = (b - a) / n
  result = f(a) + f(b)
  
  for(i in 1:(n-1))
  {
    x_i = a + i * h
    result = result + 2 * f(x_i)
  }
  
  result = (h/2) * result
  
  return(result)
}
```


## (c)
```{r}
simpson = function(f, a, b, n)
{
  if (n %% 2 != 0)
  {
    stop("n must be even")
  }
  
  h = (b - a) / n
  result = f(a) + f(b)
  
  for (i in 1:(n-1))
  {
    x_i = a + i * h
    
    if (i %% 2 == 1)
    {
      result = result + 4 * f(x_i)
    }
    else
    {
      result = result + 2 * f(x_i)
    }
  }
  result = (h/3) * result
  
  return(result)
}
```

## (e)
```{r}
n_values = c(10, 30, 60, 100, 150, 200)
true_value = -cos(pi) + cos(0)          

error_left = numeric(length(n_values))
error_trapezoid = numeric(length(n_values))
error_simpson = numeric(length(n_values))

for (i in 1:(length(n_values)))
{
  n = n_values[i]
  
  error_left[i] = abs(left_rectangle(sin, 0, pi, n) - true_value)
  error_trapezoid[i] = abs(trapezoid(sin, 0, pi, n) - true_value)
  error_simpson[i] = abs(simpson(sin, 0, pi, n) - true_value)
}

df = data.frame(
  n = n_values,
  Left = error_left,
  Trapezoid = error_trapezoid,
  Simpson = error_simpson
)

library(ggplot2)

p = ggplot(df, aes(x = n, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Left, color = "Left Rectangle")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Trapezoid, color = "Trapezoid")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Simpson, color = "Simpson")) +
  labs(x = "n", y = "Absolute Error", color = "Method")

print(p)

ggsave("plots/problem4.png", plot = p)
```




# **Problem 5**

## (a)
```{r}
A = matrix(c(4, 2, 2, 
             2, 5, 1,
             2, 1, 3), nrow = 3)
L = t(chol(A))
print(L)

print(L%*%t(L))   
```


## (b)
```{r}
forward = function(L, b)
{
  n = length(b)
  z = numeric(n)
  
  for (i in 1:n)
  {
    result = b[i]
    
    if (i > 1)
    {
      for (j in 1:(i-1))
      {
        result = result - L[i, j] * z[j]
      }
    }
    z[i] = result / L[i, i]
  }
  return(z)
}
```


## (c)
```{r}
backward = function(L, z)
{
  n = length(b)
  x = numeric(n)
  
  for (i in n:1)
  {
    result = z[i]
    
    if (i < n)
    {
      for(j in (i+1):n)
      {
        result = result - L[j, i] * x[j]
      }
    }
    x[i] = result / L[i, i]
  }
  return(x)
}
```

```{r}
all.equal(x, solve(A, b))
```




# **Problem 6**

## (a)
```{r}
gaussian_kernel = function(x, x_prime, rho = 1)
{
  result = exp(-rho * abs(x  - x_prime)^2)
  
  return(result)
}
```


## (b)
```{r}
krr = function(X, y, lambda = 0.0001, rho = 1)
{
  n = nrow(X)
  K = matrix(0, n, n)
  
  for (i in 1:n)
  {
    for (j in 1:n)
    {
      K[i, j] = gaussian_kernel(X[i, 1], X[j, 1], rho)
    }
  }
  
  alpha = solve(K + lambda * diag(n), y)
  
  result = list(X = X, y = y, alpha = alpha, rho = rho)
  class(result) = "krr"
  
  return(result)
}
```


## (c)
```{r}
predict.krr = function(object, newdata)
{
  X = object$X
  alpha = object$alpha
  rho = object$rho
  
  n = nrow(X)
  m = nrow(newdata)
  
  pred = numeric(m)
  
  for (i in 1:m)
  {
    result = 0
    
    for(j in 1:n)
    {
      result = result + gaussian_kernel(newdata[i, 1], X[j, 1], rho) * alpha[j]
    }
    pred[i] = result
  }
  
  return(pred)
}
```


## (d)
```{r}
plot.krr = function(x)
{
  X = x$X
  y = x$y
  
  x_new = matrix(seq(min(X), max(X), length.out = 200), ncol = 1)
  y_pred = predict(x, x_new)
  
  plot(X[, 1], y, pch = 16, col = 'black',
       xlab = "x", ylab = "y")
  
  lines(x_new[, 1], y_pred, col = "red", lwd = 2)
}
```
